promises.title: Establish state-of-the-art, well-equipped tertiary healthcare facilities in designated medical villages
promises.promise_blog:
Tertiary care, is a level above secondary health care, that has been defined as highly specialised medical care, usually provided over an extended period of time, that involves advanced and complex diagnostics, procedures and treatments performed by medical specialists in state-of-the-art facilities. As such tertiary healthcare centres should have access to more specialised equipment and expertise.

Examples of tertiary care services include specialist cancer management, neurosurgery, cardiac surgery, transplant services, plastic surgery, treatment for severe burns, advanced neonatology services, palliative, and other complex medical and surgical interventions.

In his manifesto for the 2023 Gubernatorial Elections for Abia State, Dr. Alex Otti, promised to establish state-of-the-art, well equipped, modern tertiary health care facilities in the state in identified medical villages, resourced by some of the best medical personnel in the diaspora and locally, to position the state to take advantage of the over $1.6 billion medical tourism industry in Nigeria.
promises.description: Establish State of the Art, well equipped, modern tertiary health care facilities in the state in identified medical villages, resourced by some of the best medical personnel in the diaspora and locally, to position the state to take advantage of the over $1.6 billion medical tourism industry in Nigeria.

promises.title: set up a full-fledge ministry to take charge of aba
promises.promise_blog:
Governor Alex Otti’s promise to establish a full-fledged ministry to oversee Aba reflects his recognition of the city’s immense potential as an economic powerhouse in Abia State. Aba, known as the "Enyimba City," is the commercial nerve center of the state, renowned for its vibrant markets, manufacturing hubs, and entrepreneurial spirit. However, years of neglect and infrastructural decay have limited its growth and capacity to contribute fully to the state’s economy.

The proposed ministry will focus on revitalizing Aba’s infrastructure, improving urban planning, and addressing the unique challenges facing its industries and residents. This specialized approach will ensure a more strategic allocation of resources to areas like road networks, waste management, and the modernization of markets. Additionally, the ministry will work to attract investments, enhance industrial capacity, and provide support for small and medium enterprises (SMEs), which are the backbone of Aba’s economy.

Governor Otti’s vision emphasizes the importance of creating a dedicated institution to prioritize Aba’s development and restore its status as a hub for innovation and commerce. By implementing this initiative, Aba can become a model city that drives economic growth, creates jobs, and improves the quality of life for its residents.
promises.description: Set up a full-fledge ministry to take charge of Aba, with the responsibility to design, implement and provide key enablement for the economic rejuvenation of Aba as an industrial and commercial hub, with the capacity to feed the Nigerian and African market.

promises.title: ensure that local government elections are conducted on schedule
promises.promise_blog:
Governor Alex Otti’s promise to ensure the timely conduct of local government elections in Abia State highlights his commitment to fostering grassroots democracy and effective governance. Local governments are the closest administrative units to the people, playing a pivotal role in service delivery, community development, and participatory governance. However, irregular or delayed elections have historically weakened their functionality, leading to over-reliance on caretaker committees and diminished accountability.

Governor Otti’s initiative aims to uphold the constitutional mandate of conducting periodic elections for local government leadership. This effort will ensure that the people of Abia State have a voice in selecting their local representatives, fostering transparency and empowering communities to influence decision-making processes directly.

To achieve this, the administration plans to collaborate with the Abia State Independent Electoral Commission (ABSIEC) to streamline electoral processes and adhere strictly to the electoral timetable. By promoting free, fair, and credible elections, this move will reinvigorate local governance and strengthen institutions at the grassroots level.

This promise underscores Governor Otti’s vision for inclusive governance, where empowered local governments act as engines for sustainable development, addressing community-specific needs, and contributing significantly to the overall progress of Abia State.
promises.description: Ensure that LGA elections are conducted as and when due, offering the people an opportunity to elect those they wish to lead them.

promises.title: create the abia health insurance scheme
promises.promise_blog:
Governor Alex Otti's promise to create the Abia Health Insurance Scheme reflects a transformative step toward improving healthcare access and affordability for all residents of Abia State. This initiative aims to address longstanding challenges, including the financial barriers that prevent many citizens from accessing quality healthcare services.

The proposed scheme will focus on ensuring that every Abian, regardless of income level, has access to essential health services without facing financial hardship. It will target vulnerable populations, including women, children, and the elderly, providing them with subsidized or free healthcare coverage. By pooling resources through an insurance model, the program seeks to reduce out-of-pocket expenses and enhance the efficiency of healthcare delivery.

Governor Otti has outlined plans to partner with private sector stakeholders, health providers, and donor agencies to ensure the sustainability of the scheme. The initiative will include building capacity for healthcare facilities and workers, equipping them to meet the increased demand from insured individuals.

The Abia Health Insurance Scheme is not just a promise; it is a commitment to improving the overall well-being of Abia State residents. Its successful implementation will enhance healthcare equity, reduce preventable deaths, and set a new benchmark for public health in Nigeria.
promises.description: Create the Abia Health Insurance Scheme, to ensure affordable healthcare for a greater number of Abians in an economically viable and sustainable way.
